actions.description: Archive a Zoho Mail message.
actions.name: archive-message

actions.description: Save an email as a draft in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: create-draft

subject.description: Subject of the email. Example: "Meeting notes"

content.description: Body content of the email. Example: "Hello, please find the notes attached."

mailFormat.description: Format of the email content. Example: "html"

actions.description: Create a folder in Zoho Mail
actions.name: create-folder

folderName.description: Name of the folder to create. Example: "My Folder"

actions.description: Create a label in Zoho Mail
actions.name: create-label

labelName.description: Name of the label to create. Example: "Important"

color.description: Hex color code for the label. Example: "#FF0000"

actions.description: Add an email signature in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: create-signature

name.description: Name of the signature. Example: "Work Signature"

content.description: Content of the signature. Example: "Best regards, John."

position.description: Position of the signature. 0 = below quoted content, 1 = above quoted content.

assignUsers.description: Comma-separated email addresses to assign the signature to.

actions.description: Create a personal task in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: create-task

title.description: Title of the task. Example: "Blog Updates"

description.description: Description of the task. Example: "Announcement blog for recent revamp"

dueDate.description: Due date in DD/MM/YYYY format. Example: "23/01/2024"

reminderDate.description: Reminder date in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-23T12:34:56+05:30"

actions.description: Delete a folder and all its contents in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: delete-folder

accountId.description: The Zoho Mail account ID. Example: "4845214000000008002"

folderId.description: The ID of the folder to delete. Example: "4845214000000010002"

actions.description: Delete a label in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: delete-label

actions.description: Delete a message in Zoho Mail. Pass expunge=true to permanently delete; otherwise moves to Trash.
actions.name: delete-message

folderId.description: Folder ID containing the message. Example: "4845214000000008008"

expunge.description: Pass true to permanently delete the message. Omit or pass false to move to Trash.

actions.description: Delete an email signature in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: delete-signature

actions.description: Delete a personal task in Zoho Mail
actions.name: delete-task

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task to delete. Example: "1781108295426155000"

actions.description: Flag or unflag a Zoho Mail message.
actions.name: flag-message

messageId.description: Message ID to flag or unflag. Example: 1781108289537154100

unflag.description: Set to true to unflag the message instead of flagging it.

actions.description: Forward an email in Zoho Mail
actions.name: forward-email

folderId.description: Folder ID containing the message. Example: "4845214000000008008"

content.description: Optional custom body content for the forwarded message

actions.description: Retrieve a single account from Zoho Mail
actions.name: get-account

accountId.description: The unique ID of the account to retrieve. Example: "4845214000000008002"

actions.description: Retrieve a single folder from Zoho Mail.
actions.name: get-folder

actions.description: Retrieve a single label from Zoho Mail.
actions.name: get-label

actions.description: Retrieve the full body content of a Zoho Mail message.
actions.name: get-message-content

folderId.description: Folder ID containing the message. Example: "4845214000000008008"

messageId.description: Message ID to retrieve content for. Example: "1781108289537154100"

actions.description: Retrieve a single message's details from Zoho Mail.
actions.name: get-message

folderId.description: Folder ID containing the message. Example: "4845214000000008008"

actions.description: Retrieve all email signatures for the authenticated Zoho Mail account.
actions.name: get-signature

actions.description: Retrieve a single personal task from Zoho Mail.
actions.name: get-task

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the personal task. Example: "1781108259800155000"

actions.description: List all accounts for the authenticated user in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: list-accounts

actions.description: List all folders for an account in Zoho Mail
actions.name: list-folders

actions.description: List all labels for an account in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: list-labels

actions.description: List messages in a folder in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: list-messages

folderId.description: Folder ID to list messages from. Example: "4845214000000008008"

limit.description: Number of messages to retrieve. Max 200. Default 10.

sortorder.description: Sort order: 0 for ascending, 1 for descending. Default 1.

actions.description: List all personal tasks in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: list-tasks

limit.description: Number of tasks to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 499.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (offset) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: Mark a Zoho Mail message as read
actions.name: mark-message-read

messageId.description: Message ID to mark as read. Example: "1781108289537154100"

actions.description: Mark a Zoho Mail message as unread.
actions.name: mark-message-unread

messageId.description: Message ID to mark as unread. Example: "1781108289537154100"

actions.description: Move a Zoho Mail message to another folder.
actions.name: move-message

actions.description: Reply or reply-all to an email in Zoho Mail
actions.name: reply-to-email

messageId.description: Message ID to reply to. Example: "1781108289537154100"
ID of the sent reply message. Example: "1726208416259127700"

actions.description: Search emails in Zoho Mail by keyword.
actions.name: search-messages

searchKey.description: Zoho Mail search query string. Use syntax like "entire:keyword" or "subject:Meeting". Example: "entire:Test"

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-200). Example: 10

receivedTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds to filter emails received before this time. Example: 1609459200000

includeto.description: Whether to include the To field in the response. Example: true

actions.description: Send an email through Zoho Mail
actions.name: send-email

accountId.description: Account ID from which to send the email. Example: "4845214000000008002"

statusCode.description: HTTP status code from the API

data.description: Additional response data from the API

actions.description: Update (rename or move) a folder in Zoho Mail
actions.name: update-folder

folderName.description: New folder name (required when mode is rename)

parentFolderId.description: Destination parent folder ID (used when mode is move)

previousFolderId.description: Folder ID to position after in the destination parent (used when mode is move)

actions.description: Update a label's name or color in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: update-label

labelName.description: New display name for the label

color.description: Hex color code for the label. Example: #FF0000

actions.description: Update an email signature in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: update-signature

id.description: The unique ID of the signature to update. Example: "2442552000000433009"

name.description: The updated name of the signature.

content.description: The updated content of the signature.

position.description: The preferred position of the signature. 0 = below quoted content, 1 = above quoted content.

assignUsers.description: Comma-separated email addresses to assign this signature to.

unassignUsers.description: Comma-separated email addresses to unassign this signature from.

actions.description: Update a personal task in Zoho Mail.
actions.name: update-task

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the task to update. Example: "1781108259800155000"

dueDate.description: New due date for the task. Format: DD/MM/YYYY.

reminderDate.description: Reminder date and time in ISO 8601 format.

actions.description: Upload a file attachment to Zoho Mail for use in a subsequent send-email call.
actions.name: upload-attachment

fileName.description: Name of the file to upload. Example: "test.txt"

isInline.description: Whether to show the attachment inline in the email body.

syncs.description: Sync all accounts for the authenticated user from Zoho Mail.
syncs.name: accounts

syncs.description: Sync all folders for each account from Zoho Mail
syncs.name: folders

syncs.description: Sync all labels for each account from Zoho Mail
syncs.name: labels

syncs.description: Sync messages from Zoho Mail with incremental support by receivedTime
syncs.name: messages
